title: Change a name on Social Security record
facts: After a legal name change, a person can request a corrected Social Security card from SSA.
SSA requires evidence of identity and the legal name change under its document rules; additional citizenship or immigration evidence may be required in some cases.
The corrected card keeps the same Social Security number.
Updating a name with SSA is separate from updating a driver's license, passport, employer records, banks, and other institutions.
